label: Corporate income tax (impôt sur le revenu des collectivités) [national]
value: 14% up to €175,000, 16% above €200,000 (€24,500 + 30% in between), plus the 7% employment fund surcharge; municipal business tax 3% × the commune's multiplier (225% to 350%; Luxembourg City 225%); combined 23.87% in Luxembourg City; minimum net wealth tax €535 to €4,815; 15% global minimum tax with a national top-up tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000. Paid by resident companies and Luxembourg branches of foreign companies. L.I.R. art. 159, 160 and 174; loi modifiée du 30 juin 1976 (fonds pour l'emploi); Gewerbesteuergesetz (GewStG, municipal business tax); loi du 22 décembre 2023 relative à l'imposition minimale effective.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, the employment fund surcharge and social security are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
